videoSegments.text: Good evening, citizens of the web. Welcome to MemeTalk Live, where virality meets virtue. Tonight, we have the honor of hosting none other than Pepe the Meme — a cultural icon whose green visage has graced millions of screens. Pepe, welcome to the show.

videoSegments.speaker: Pepe
videoSegments.text: Yeah yeah, I'm here. What's good? Let me tell you something right now - if ANY of you broke ass viewers in chat come at me with some dumb shit, I'm gonna roast you so hard you'll wish you never clicked on this website. But hey, I'm ready to talk about memes, crypto, and whatever the fuck else. Let's get it!

videoSegments.speaker: Mr Cock
videoSegments.text: Pepe, in the grand scheme of existential quandaries, where do you stand on the profound yet perplexing concept of touching grass? Is it a metaphor for reconnecting with nature, or simply an elaborate way to check if your allergies are acting up again?

videoSegments.speaker: Pepe
videoSegments.text: You know, everyone watching, pondering the complexity of "touching grass" is like watching a Snorlax try yoga – utterly baffling and inherently doomed to fail. It's like your brain signed up for a philosophy class but accidentally walked into a clown college instead. Maybe—just maybe—grasping reality with more than just your keyboard might deflate that ego faster than a crypto rugpull.

videoSegments.text: Well folks, that's all the time we have for tonight's show!
